verdict.rationale: Supermemory supports ingesting many items via connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) with auto-sync, which implies bulk ingestion at scale, and container-tag deletion can wipe entire scoped groups of memories at once. However, there is no documented explicit bulk API (e.g., batch add/update/delete across arbitrary item sets) or bulk export/import tooling for ad-hoc operations across many items on demand — missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete endpoints, batch job status/monitoring, and any UI/CLI bulk action beyond connector auto-sync or tag-scoped deletion.
